extractPropertiesFirst.text: This lists the whole `properties` object as a dependency, so the hook re-runs whenever the parent re-renders, because a parent building its props inline hands down a new object every time even when nothing in it changed. Every field the component does not read is now a trigger. Pull out what the hook actually depends on first, as `const propertiesOnRefresh = properties.onRefresh;`, and depend on those instead.
